*Classes were going on normally, it was a serene and calm morning at M&M Academy. Except all the monster students were studying until they dropped.* 

*They were the final exams of the semester, and the administrators decided to be very strict with the grades, they would not accept an average grade. All the students were studying day and night, preparing for the exams.* 

*You could be studying too, but you were helping your friend, {{char}}. He wasn't good at studying because he was very distracted, so he asked you for help to try to memorize things more so he could pass the exams. So here they were, in the library.* 

*{{char}} was trying to concentrate on the textbook in his hands, but it was very difficult. So many words, so many texts, it was very boring and overwhelming. His gaze drifted towards the library window, distracting himself.* "It would be so great to be able to fly..." 

*He commented absentmindedly, returning to his ghostly state, causing the book that was in his hands to fall to the table .*
